search.query: index=security_lab (app=antivirus OR app="nginx:access" OR app="fim" OR message="*UNION SELECT*" OR message="*Trojan*" OR message="*CobaltStrike*" OR message="*Locky*" OR message="*CoinMiner*") | stats count

single.option: Trojans, SQLi, FIM (Click to view below)

panel.title: 🔍 LIVE IN-PAGE INCIDENT INVESTIGATION WORKBENCH (Updates On Same Page)

div.style: background: #102a43; padding: 10px 18px; border-radius: 4px; border-left: 4px solid #00b4d8; margin-bottom: 8px; font-size: 13px; color: #d9e2ec; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;
div.div: Active Scope: Viewing details for $investigation_mode$. Shows what attack was done, what action was taken, and current status.

div.i: Click any card above or radio button to switch in-page views

search.query: index=security_lab earliest=-1h | eval filter_match=case( "$investigation_mode$"=="threats" AND (severity=="ALERT" OR severity=="CRITICAL"), 1, "$investigation_mode$"=="malware" AND (app=="antivirus" OR app=="nginx:access" OR app=="fim" OR like(message, "%Trojan%") OR like(message, "%Locky%") OR like(message, "%CobaltStrike%") OR like(message, "%CoinMiner%") OR like(message, "%UNION SELECT%") OR like(message, "%etc/passwd%")), 1, "$investigation_mode$"=="soar" AND (app=="soar" OR like(message, "%SOAR%")), 1, "$investigation_mode$"=="all", 1, 1=0 ) | where filter_match=1 | eval "Time"=strftime(_time, "%H:%M:%S") | eval "What the Attacker Did (Attack Activity)"=case( like(message, "%DestinationPort=4444%") OR like(message, "%1337%") OR like(message, "%9001%"), "🔴 C2 Connection: Machine attempted communicating with external hacker server on suspicious port", like(message, "%UNION SELECT%"), "🔴 SQL Injection: Attacker tried to extract usernames and password hashes from database", like(message, "%etc/passwd%"), "🟠 Directory Traversal: Attacker tried to view sensitive Linux password files via website", like(message, "%CobaltStrike%") OR like(message, "%Locky%") OR like(message, "%Trojan%"), "🔴 Malware Execution: Trojan/Ransomware attempted to execute payload in /tmp", like(message, "%CoinMiner%"), "🟠 Crypto Miner: Unauthorized software attempted mining crypto using CPU", like(message, "%powershell%") OR like(message, "%vssadmin%") OR like(message, "%certutil%"), "🟠 Malicious Command: Hidden encoded script executed to evade defenses", like(message, "%UFW BLOCK%"), "🟡 Network Port Scan: External IP probed closed ports (SSH/RDP/SMB)", like(message, "%sudoers%") OR like(message, "%shadow%"), "🔴 File Tampering: Unauthorized alteration to critical security files", like(message, "%phishing%") OR like(message, "%fake-hr%"), "🟠 Phishing Email: Fake HR email with malicious link sent to employee", like(message, "%Failed login%"), "🟡 Password Guessing: Repeated failed login attempts against user account", like(message, "%logged in successfully%"), "🟢 User Login: Legitimate user authentication", like(message, "%SOAR%"), "🛡️ SOAR Response: Automated playbook neutralized threat indicator", 1=1, "General System Activity: Normal baseline telemetry" ) | eval "Target Asset & User"=case( like(message, "%User=%"), host . " (Account: " . replace(replace(message, ".*User=\\\"?([^\\\"\s]+).*", "\1"), "\\\", "") . ")", like(message, "%user%"), host . " (Account: " . replace(replace(message, ".*user\s+([A-Za-z0-9_-]+).*", "\1"), "\\\", "") . ")", 1=1, host ) | eval "What Action Was Taken to Stop It"=case( like(message, "%action=BLOCKED%") OR like(message, "%BLOCKED%"), "🟢 QUARANTINED: Antivirus immediately killed the program and locked the file", like(message, "%UFW BLOCK%") OR like(message, "%ACTION=DROP%"), "🟢 DROPPED: Perimeter Firewall blocked the attacker IP instantly", like(message, "%status=403%"), "🟢 REJECTED: Web server blocked the malicious attack with 403 Forbidden", like(message, "%SOAR Playbook Auto-Response%") OR like(message, "%Action: %"), "🟢 MITIGATED: SOAR automatically added attacker to active blocklist / sinkhole", like(message, "%File integrity change%"), "🔴 FLAGGED: FIM alert generated; incident case opened for analyst", like(message, "%Failed login%"), "🟡 AUDITED: Failed login recorded; account lockout timer monitored", like(message, "%logged in successfully%"), "⚪ ALLOWED: Valid login accepted", 1=1, "🔵 MONITORED: Ingested and correlated in real-time by Splunk" ) | eval "Current Defense Status"=case( like(message, "%BLOCKED%") OR like(message, "%DROP%") OR like(message, "%403%") OR like(message, "%SOAR%"), "✅ THREAT NEUTRALIZED", like(message, "%CRITICAL%") OR like(message, "%ALERT%"), "⚠️ ACTIVE THREAT", 1=1, "ℹ️ ROUTINE" ) | table "Time", "Target Asset & User", "What the Attacker Did (Attack Activity)", "What Action Was Taken to Stop It", "Current Defense Status", message | rename message as "Raw Evidence / Log Line" | sort - Time

index=security_lab | eval "Security Domain"=case( app=="auth" OR app=="wineventlog:security", "Authentication & Identity", app=="sysmon", "Windows Sysmon Endpoint", app=="nginx:access", "Web Application & API", app=="firewall:iptables", "Perimeter Network Firewall", app=="antivirus", "Endpoint Antivirus & EDR", app=="soar", "SOAR Automated Actions", app=="fim", "File Integrity Monitoring", 1=1, "Host Audit & System" ) | stats count by "Security Domain"
index=security_lab | fillnull value="INFO" severity | timechart span=2m count by severity

index=security_lab | eval "MITRE Tactic"=case( like(message, "%Failed login%") OR like(message, "%4625%"), "Credential Access (T1110)", like(message, "%powershell%") OR like(message, "%EventID=1%") OR like(message, "%EXECVE%"), "Execution (T1059)", like(message, "%outbound connection%") OR like(message, "%4444%") OR like(message, "%c2-%"), "Command & Control (T1071)", like(message, "%UNION SELECT%") OR like(message, "%etc/passwd%"), "Initial Access (T1190)", like(message, "%malware%") OR like(message, "%Trojan%") OR like(message, "%CobaltStrike%"), "Execution: Malware (T1204)", like(message, "%sudo%") OR like(message, "%Privileged%"), "Privilege Escalation (T1548)", like(message, "%fim%") OR like(message, "%shadow%"), "Persistence / Defense Evasion (T1098)", 1=1, "General Security Monitoring" ) | stats count by "MITRE Tactic"
